title: B193 — Spike: share Linear outward, read-only (project links vs initiative roadmaps)
description:
## Why

Found as Linear integrations in the B119 walk's Customer Experience category (2026-09-26). The one need there that doesn't wait on users: **show the lab's work to people who aren't in Linear** — family (the owner's sons, before they're Linear users) and a portfolio showcase beside B191's YouTube demos. Linear itself only shows projects to workspace members or paid guests.

## Candidates

| Tool | What it shares | Free tier |
| -- | -- | -- |
| **Lindie** | private, read-only links to a Linear project, viewable without a Linear account | **1 shareable project** |
| **Helium Rooms** | Linear boards shared with outsiders in read-only "rooms" | verify |
| **Feedvote** | a client portal + public roadmap built on Linear | verify |
| **Roadmark** | turns a **Linear initiative into a shareable roadmap** — shares goals + progress, not raw issues (fits B119.1's OKRs; sidesteps the sensitive-issue risk) | verify |
| **SteelSync** | private / public board views of Linear data | verify |
| **Alignear** | client portal + automated cycle reports (plus client-facing AI/requests, out of scope) | verify |

## Technical context

| Where | What | Role |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Linear | the project to share (e.g. Weyland Lab), its issues, updates and initiative | source |
| external | the chosen tool's hosted viewer (OAuth to Linear) | read-only view |
| repo | `docs/concepts/linear-evaluation.md` (B119 record) | verdict |

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each candidate's free tier verified from its pricing page (what is shared, how many projects, expiry).
- [ ] One project shared with the top candidate; opened in a private browser window with **no Linear login** and it shows current status.
- [ ] Confirmed read-only: a viewer cannot edit, comment into Linear, or see other projects.
- [ ] Verdict recorded (adopt / don't) with the chosen project and link policy.

## Edge cases & failure modes

* A link leaks further than intended → it must be revocable; check revocation works.
* Issues can contain internal hostnames or sensitive notes → decide which project is safe to share (or filter), before sharing.
* The tool's OAuth scope to Linear — read-only preferred; reject any that need write access.

## Out of scope

* Customer-facing portals for the product apps (the B188 stack).
* Giving anyone a Linear seat.
* Paid tiers.

Relates B119, B191 (public demos on YouTube), B188. Detail: [https://github.com/edtbl76/weyland-lab/blob/main/docs/backlog.md](<https://github.com/edtbl76/weyland-lab/blob/main/docs/backlog.md>)
